Counts are Mobi bike-share trips only, a small sample of everyone cycling. Routes are modelled shortest bike-friendly paths, not GPS traces, so volumes pile onto the single best route more than real riders do. Weekday figures are trips per weekday inside the three-hour block; weekend figures are trips per whole weekend day.
